mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5% for two consecutive months, it signals persistent monetary tightening that precedes imminent rate cuts, compressing equity discount rates and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 4.5% for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A month-over-month increase in the unemployment rate signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE increases month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent decline in housing starts (HOUST) and real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) over two months indicates severe aggregate demand contraction, triggering recessionary expectations that produce negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS decline for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: During post-crisis recovery periods (FEDFUNDS ≤ 2.0% and CPIAUCSL < 2.0% annualized), a decline in the federal funds rate signals sustained accommodative policy that supports equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances during the post-crisis recovery regime.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100 (index), it indicates a significant manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate profitability and triggers negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO < 100.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts (HOUST) decline below 1400 thousand units signals weakening residential investment that dampens consumer confidence and corporate revenue growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where HOUST < 1400.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) and rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates severe labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, generating negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises simultaneously.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly real GDP growth rate below 0.5% annualized (from GDPC1) signals deepening recessionary conditions that reduce corporate earnings expectations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where GDPC1 growth rate < 0.5% annualized.
